title: Before and after screenshots, side by side
dek: The build story in under a minute: pairs that find each other in the pull request comment, and a divider on the file page.

scenes.label: Build notes
scenes.headline: Before and after screenshots, side by side

scenes.label: The problem
lines: Most pull request screenshots come in pairs.
They showed up *one under the other*.

scenes.label: 01 · Pairs that find each other
scenes.headline: Tag the state, and the pair shares a row.
scenes.sub: Same page, one before and one after. Anything else stays as it was.

regions.say: One page, before and after: one row
No before to match: it shows on its own

scenes.label: 02 · A divider instead of thumbnails
scenes.headline: Small thumbnails hid the change.
scenes.sub: So the comparison moved into the main view, at full size.

scenes.label: 03 · Two shots that line up
scenes.headline: Drag the divider across both.
scenes.sub: The before is anchored at the top-left of the after, so what moved is what changed.

scenes.label: 04 · The pair that overwrote itself
lines: One name, so the after *replaced* the before.
Now the state is part of the name.

scenes.label: Try it
scenes.headline: Tag each side with its state.
scenes.foot: uploads put or uploads screenshot, once for each side. Docs: uploads.sh/docs/attach-pull-request-images
